body_parser.comment: processEmail carries base64 PDF attachments; the 100kb default rejects any real invoice.

[production].comment: Deployed, the write path reaches S/4 through the same subaccount destination the UI reads through (the approuter route in app/router/xs-app.json uses ABMY_INVOICE_REVIEW_S4, the host root; this one already points at the service root, so no `path` is needed). Requires the destination service bound to ai_cap-srv — see mta.yaml. Having credentials here is also what makes invoice-writer's writeTarget() pick 's4'. Scoped to [production] so plain `cds watch` stays on the local mock; the `s4` profile still binds the user-provided service via .cdsrc-private.json.
